opponent.label: Adora
opponent.from: She-Ra and the Princesses of Power
opponent.description:
Adora is the lead warrior of the Princess Alliance of the planet Etheria and the wielder of the mythical Sword of Protection. Using its magical powers, she's able to transform into the legendary She-Ra, a being of pure magic and sworn protector of Etheria. She uses her newfound power to fight in the war against the Horde, a group bent on dominating the entire planet, and the very same group that raised Adora from infancy. It's very stressful fighting her former faction and helping protect her new friends, so she came here for a break.

Hint: If her text is blue when the game starts, she will transform into She-Ra later.
